fix.shows: Frontline reports a preliminary analysis by the Sabar Institute of the names left off Telangana's draft roll outside Hyderabad, where more than 53 lakh electors were placed on the list of absent, shifted, dead and duplicate electors after the enumeration phase. By the magazine's account the analysis finds patterns in these names by religion, gender and constituency, and suggests that they have a distinct pattern in the constituencies the BJP won in the 2023 Assembly election. Its standfirst says the names left off disproportionately affect Muslim voters, especially through the category untraceable.
